salivate: Dogs salivate when they see food.
狗狗一看到食物就会流口水。
Do you salivate when you eat candy?
你吃糖果的时候会流口水吗？
Wow, that pie makes me salivate!
哇，那个派馋得我直流口水！
salutation: The letter starts with a salutation.
信的开头要先写问候语。
What salutation can you use in a card?
贺卡里你可以用什么样的问候语呢？
Give a salutation with a big smile!
带着大大的笑容打个招呼吧！
salvage: Workers salvage logs from the river.
工人们从河里打捞木头。
Can we salvage the wet books?
我们能把湿掉的书抢救回来吗？
Let's salvage what we can from the box!
咱们把盒子里还能用的东西都抢救出来吧！
salvager: The salvager finds old pots in the ocean.
打捞者在海里找到了旧罐子。
Who is the salvager on that old boat?
那条旧船上打捞东西的人是谁呀？
Watch the salvager work by the dock!
快看码头边打捞者干活！
salvation: The big boat was our salvation.
那条大船就是我们的救星。
Is water the plant's salvation on a hot day?
大热天里，水就是小植物的救星吗？
Your help was my salvation today!
你今天的帮忙真是帮了我大忙！
sanction: The school gave its sanction for the picnic.
学校批准了这次野餐活动。
Did mother give her sanction for the camp?
妈妈同意你去夏令营了吗？
No sanction, no swimming in the lake!
没有许可，就不能在湖里游泳！
sanctuary: The bird sanctuary has a lot of geese.
这个鸟类保护区里有好多鹅。
Is the sanctuary open to little birds?
这个保护区对小鸟开放吗？
欢迎来到我们的熊猫保护区！
sandbar: Seals sleep on the warm sandbar.
海豹在温暖的沙洲上睡觉。
Can you see the sandbar from the dock?
从码头上你能看到那片沙洲吗？
sandstone: The cliff is made of red sandstone.
这座悬崖是红砂岩做成的。
Is this rock sandstone or coral?
这块石头是砂岩还是珊瑚呀？
Feel this warm sandstone in the sun!
摸摸这块被太阳晒得暖暖的砂岩！
sanguine: The sanguine kid always finds fun games.
这个乐观的孩子总能找到好玩的游戏。
Are you sanguine about the game today?
你对今天的比赛抱乐观态度吗？
Be sanguine and smile at the new kid!
乐观点儿，对新同学笑一笑吧！
sanitation: Good sanitation keeps our school clean.
良好的卫生让我们的学校干干净净。
Why do cities need good sanitation?
为什么城市需要好的公共卫生呢？
Clean water helps with sanitation at camp!
干净的水对营地卫生很重要哦！
sarcastic: His sarcastic words made her cry.
他那些挖苦的话把她弄哭了。
Is he being sarcastic right now?
Don't be sarcastic to your friends!
不要对朋友说风凉话哦！
sarcophagus: We read about a sarcophagus at school.
我们在学校读到了石棺的故事。
Is the sarcophagus in the old city?
那个石棺是在古城里发现的吗？
sass: Stop the sass and say sorry, please!
别顶嘴了，快说声对不起吧！
Why does the little parrot give sass?
这只小鹦鹉为什么要嘴巴不客气呢？
The duck's sass made us all laugh.
那只鸭子的贫嘴把我们都逗笑了。
satisfaction: A clean room gives me satisfaction.
干净的房间让我特别有满足感。
Do you feel satisfaction when you help?
你帮忙之后会觉得心满意足吗？
What satisfaction when the seeds come up!
种子冒出芽来，多有成就感呀！
sauna: Grandfather sits in the hot sauna.
爷爷坐在热热的桑拿房里。
Is the sauna too hot for you?
桑拿房对你来说是不是太热了？
The warm sauna feels so good!
暖暖的桑拿房真舒服呀！
savage: The savage waves rocked the small boat.
狂暴的海浪摇得小船晃来晃去。
Is the tiger in the story savage?
故事里的那只老虎很凶吗？
The story's savage bear was just a dream!
故事里那只凶巴巴的熊原来只是个梦！
savings: My savings are in a little blue box.
我的积蓄放在一个小蓝盒子里。
Can I use my savings for a gift?
我可以用我的积蓄买一份礼物吗？
My savings can buy a new kite now!
我的积蓄现在够买一只新风筝啦！
savor: Savor this warm cookie with milk.
慢慢品尝这块配牛奶的热饼干吧。
Do you savor your food at lunch?
你吃午饭时会细细品味食物吗？
He savors every noodle in his bowl.
他把碗里的每一根面条都吃得津津有味。
scandal: Our story is about a scandal at school.
我们的故事讲的是学校里的一桩丑闻。
Did you hear about the cookie scandal?
Never start a scandal about your friends!
千万不要编造关于朋友的丑闻哦！
scarab: The green scarab is a small beetle.
绿色的圣甲虫是一种小甲虫。
Did you see the blue scarab on the leaf?
你看到叶子上的蓝色圣甲虫了吗？
Look at the little black scarab!
快看那只黑色的小圣甲虫！
scarce: Water is scarce in the hot summer.
炎热的夏天里，水很稀缺。
Is food scarce for the winter birds?
冬天鸟儿的食物很短缺吗？
Fish are scarce in the small pond now!
现在小池塘里的鱼很少啦！
scat: Scat, little bird, and find another tree!
去吧小鸟，去找别的树吧！
Did the dog make the cat scat?
The bunny had to scat fast.
小兔子只好赶紧溜走了。
scattered: The dog scattered the leaves in the garden.
小狗把花园里的叶子弄得到处都是。
Why are your blocks scattered on the rug?
你的积木怎么撒了一地毯呀？
The seeds are scattered all over the field!
scavenger: A crab is a little ocean scavenger.
螃蟹是海里的小小清道夫。
Is the crow a scavenger too?
乌鸦也是捡食残渣的动物吗？
What a little scavenger you are, little crab!
小螃蟹，你可真是个捡食小能手呀！
scent: The dog knows my scent at the door.
狗狗在门口就闻出了我的气味。
Does the flower have a nice scent?
The scent of hot bread makes me smile!
热面包的香味让我忍不住微笑！
schedule: The bus schedule is on the wall.
公交车时刻表就在墙上。
What is on your schedule today?
你今天的日程安排了什么呀？
My schedule has a lot of fun things!
我的日程表上有好多好玩的事！
schemer: The schemer in the story wants every cookie.
故事里那个爱耍花招的家伙想要所有的饼干。
Is the fox the schemer in this story?
这个故事里的狐狸就是那个爱耍花招的家伙吗？
Be a friend, not a schemer!
要做个好朋友，不要耍小心眼哦！
scholar: The little scholar reads many big books.
这个小学者读了好多大部头的书。
Does a scholar work in a library?
学者是在图书馆里工作的吗？
Be a scholar and read every day!
做个小小学者，每天都读书吧！
schooner: A big schooner sits near the dock.
一艘大帆船停在码头附近。
Did you see the white schooner at the coast?
你在海边看到那艘白色帆船了吗？
The little schooner looks so cool!
那艘小帆船看起来真酷！
scorch: Don't scorch the bread in the toaster!
别把面包在烤面包机里烤糊啦！
Did the hot sun scorch the little plants?
火辣辣的太阳把小苗晒伤了吗？
The hot pan can scorch the corn.
烧得烫烫的锅会把玉米烤糊的。
scorched: The scorched bread is on the old pan.
烤糊的面包还在旧锅里呢。
Did you eat the scorched cookie?
那块烤糊的饼干你吃了吗？
The scorched popcorn is all black now!
爆米花已经糊得黑乎乎的了！
scour: We scour the sand for little crab holes.
我们在沙地里仔细找小螃蟹的洞。
Does she scour the house for her doll?
她在家里翻来翻去地找她的娃娃吗？
Scour the old pot with soap and water!
用肥皂水把旧锅使劲刷干净吧！
scraping: I hear a scraping at the window.
我听到窗子上有刮擦的声音。
What is making that scraping noise?
那个刮来刮去的响声是谁弄的呀？
Oh no, the scraping on my plate is back!
哎呀，盘子上的刮擦声又来了！
screech: The owl's screech comes at night.
猫头鹰的尖叫声在夜里响起。
Did you hear the parrot screech in the jungle?
你听到丛林里鹦鹉的尖叫了吗？
What a big screech from the little parrot!
这只小鹦鹉的叫声可真尖啊！
scribe: The scribe writes with a thin feather.
抄写员用细细的羽毛笔写字。
Did the scribe write on paper?
那个抄写员是在纸上写字的吗？
Be the scribe and write our words!
你来当抄写员，把大家说的话写下来吧！
scrumptious: Grandmother made a scrumptious apple pie.
奶奶做了一个超级好吃的苹果派。
Does the scrumptious cupcake have chocolate inside?
这个美味的小蛋糕里面有巧克力吗？
What a scrumptious lunch we had today!
我们今天的午餐真是太美味啦！
scrutiny: The old map got close scrutiny from us.
我们仔细地察看了那张旧地图。
Does your work need close scrutiny too?
你的作业也需要认真检查一遍吗？
Look at the bug under close scrutiny!
来近距离仔细观察这只小虫子吧！
sculpted: The sculpted snowman has a big smile.
雕好的雪人有一个大大的笑容。
Who sculpted this horse out of the sand?
这匹沙雕的马是谁雕的呀？
Look at the sculpted sand tiger!
scurry: Watch the little crabs scurry into the sand.
看小螃蟹们急急忙忙钻进沙子里。
Why do bugs scurry when the cat comes?
猫一来，小虫子们为什么急着乱跑呀？
The birds scurry home when it rains.
下雨了，小鸟们急匆匆地赶回家。
scurvy: The story tells about scurvy on old boats.
这个故事讲了旧船上发生的坏血病。
Did eating fruit stop scurvy on boats?
在船上吃水果能预防坏血病吗？
scute: The turtle's back has a hard scute.
乌龟背上有硬硬的甲片。
Can you find every scute on the crocodile's back?
你能找到鳄鱼背上的每一片甲片吗？
What a small scute on the big turtle!
大乌龟身上的甲片真小呀！
sea level: The water at sea level goes up and down.
海平面的海水会上下起伏。
Is our city close to sea level?
我们的城市离海平面很近吗？
In the hot summer, sea level can go up!
炎热的夏天里，海平面会升高哦！
seamount: A seamount is a tall rock under the ocean.
海底山是大海深处高高的石头山。
Can fish live near a seamount?
鱼儿能住在海底山附近吗？
Look at the whale over the tall seamount!
快看那只在海底山上方游过的鲸鱼！
seaport: The old seaport has many boats and docks.
这座古老的海港有许多船和码头。
Does the little seaport have a fish market?
What a big seaport near our city!
我们城市附近的海港好大呀！
search engine: The search engine finds words very fast.
搜索引擎找起词语来飞快。
What does the search engine say about pandas?
搜索引擎上关于熊猫都说了什么呀？
Use the search engine on the computer!
在电脑上用搜索引擎查一查吧！
secede: The story tells how some cities wanted to secede.
这个故事讲了一些城市想脱离出去的事。
Did the city really want to secede?
那座城市真的想脱离吗？
The book says a city cannot secede!
书上说城市是不能脱离出去的！
secession: We read about secession in our book.
我们在书上读到了脱离的历史。
Did the book say why the secession started?
书上说没说脱离是怎么开始的呀？
What a hard time the secession was!
那场分裂带来的日子可真苦啊！
secluded: Our tent sits in a secluded spot.
我们的帐篷搭在一个僻静的地方。
Do you like the secluded spot under the tree?
你喜欢树荫下那个僻静的小角落吗？
Find a secluded spot for our picnic!
给我们的野餐找个僻静的地方吧！
secondhand: My secondhand bike is blue and fast.
我的二手自行车是蓝色的，骑起来飞快。
Did you buy that secondhand book at the store?
那本旧书是你在店里买的吗？
A secondhand toy can be a nice gift!
二手玩具也可以是一份很棒的礼物！
secrecy: A little secrecy makes the game fun.
玩游戏时保守一点小秘密才有趣。
Why does the game need secrecy?
这个游戏为什么需要保密呀？
Keep the secrecy and find a good spot!
守住秘密，找个好地方躲好！
security: The seatbelt gives us security in the car.
安全带让我们在车里很安心。
Does the school have security at the gate?
你的抱抱就是我的安全感！
sedentary: A sedentary day is not good for the body.
一整天坐着不动对身体不好。
Are you sedentary all day at your desk?
你是不是一整天都坐在书桌前呀？
Don't be sedentary like the old couch potato!
别像个小电视迷一样总是坐着不动哦！
seep: Water can seep under the old door.
水会从旧门缝里渗进来。
Does the rain seep into the tent?
Oh no, the water will seep into our shoes!
呀，水要渗进我们的鞋子里啦！
segregation: We read a story about segregation at school.
我们在学校读了一个关于种族隔离的故事。
Was segregation hard for many families?
种族隔离是不是让很多家庭很受苦？
All friends play together, with no segregation!
所有的朋友一起玩，不分彼此！
seismic: Seismic waves can make the water dance.
地震波能让水花跳起舞来。
Did you feel the seismic wave at school?
你在学校感觉到地震波了吗？
What a big seismic wave that was!
那次地震波可真强烈啊！
seize: Try to seize the red ball!
Can the frog seize the fly in the air?
青蛙能抓住空中的苍蝇吗？
The eagle will seize the fish very fast.
老鹰会飞快地一把抓住那条鱼。
self-control: Self-control helps you take turns with friends.
有自控力才能和小伙伴好好轮流玩。
Do you need self-control at the candy store?
在糖果店你需要管住自己吗？
Use self-control and eat just one cookie!
管住自己，只吃一块饼干哦！
selfie: We take a selfie by the big panda.
我们在大熊猫旁边自拍。
Can I get a selfie with the snowman?
我能和雪人合张自拍吗？
Look at our family selfie on the beach!
看我们在海滩上的全家福自拍！
seminary: The old seminary is near the green field.
那座古老的神学院在绿绿的田野旁边。
Who goes to school at the seminary?
Look at the tall seminary by the river!
快看河边那座高高的神学院！
senator: The senator works for the people in our city.
参议员为我们城市的人们工作。
Does the senator live in our city too?
参议员也住在我们城市吗？
Thank you, senator, for the new park!
参议员，谢谢您给我们建了新公园！
sensibility: She has a fine sensibility for music.
她对音乐有很好的感受力。
Do you sing with a lot of sensibility?
你唱歌的时候带着感情吗？
Your sensibility makes you a good friend!
你的善解人意让你成为好朋友！
sensor: The robot has a sensor in its head.
机器人的脑袋里装着一个传感器。
What does the little sensor on the door do?
门上那个小传感器是做什么用的呀？
The sensor sees the ball and the door opens!
传感器一看到球，门就开了！
sensory: The baby likes sensory play with water and sand.
小宝宝喜欢玩水和沙子的感官游戏。
What sensory game can we play today?
我们今天能玩什么感官游戏呀？
Sensory play is so much fun!
sentry: The sentry watches the big gate.
Does the sentry stand at the fort all night?
哨兵要在堡垒站一整夜吗？
Be a sentry and watch the fort gate!
来当哨兵，守好堡垒的大门吧！
sequence: Put the story cards in the right sequence.
把故事卡片按正确的顺序排好吧。
这一列数从哪个数字开始呀？
One, two, three is an easy sequence!
一、二、三是个简单的数列！
sergeant: The sergeant helps people in our city.
这位警官帮着我们城市里的人们。
Does the sergeant work near the school gate?
警官是不是在学校门口附近工作呀？
Thank you, sergeant, for your help!
警官先生，谢谢你的帮助！
serpent: The serpent in the story is long and green.
故事里的大蛇又长又绿。
Did the serpent live in the old tree?
那条大蛇住在老树里吗？
What a big serpent in the jungle!
丛林里的这条大蛇好大呀！
serrated: 这片绿叶的边缘是锯齿状的。
Are the leaves on this plant serrated?
这种植物的叶子是锯齿形的吗？
Look at the little serrated leaves!
快看这些小小的锯齿形叶子！
serum: This serum helps people get well fast.
这种血清能帮人们快快好起来。
Does the serum go in a small bottle?
血清是装在小瓶子里的吗？
The new serum made the bear well again!
新的血清让小熊又健康起来啦！
servant: A servant worked in a very big house.
一位仆人曾在一座大宅子里干活。
Did the servant clean the old house every day?
仆人每天都打扫那座老房子吗？
The servant in the story works so hard!
故事里的仆人干活可真勤快！
serviceable: My old backpack is very serviceable.
Is the little boat serviceable for fishing?
这条小船还能用来捕鱼吗？
这辆红色小推车可真结实耐用！
setting: The setting is a red house by the ocean.
故事的地点是海边一座红房子。
What is the setting of this story?
这个故事发生在什么地方呀？
Draw the setting of the story on paper!
把故事的场景画在纸上吧！
settlement: The old settlement was near the river.
那个古老的定居点在河边。
Where was the new settlement in the book?
书里新的定居点建在哪里呀？
What a small settlement by the big lake!
大湖边的小定居点真小呀！
severe: Severe cold keeps us inside the warm house.
严寒把我们关在暖暖的屋子里。
Is the rain severe outside today?
What severe snow we had yesterday!
昨天的雪下得可真大呀！
sewage: Sewage goes under the city in big tunnels.
污水经过大管道流到城市地下。
Does the city clean the sewage?
Sewage must go far from our drinking water!
污水必须离我们的饮用水远远的！
sewer: The sewer runs under the big city.
下水道在大城市地下延伸。
Does the rain go into the sewer?
Workers clean the sewer under the street!
工人们在街道下面清理下水道！
shabby: The old hat looks a little shabby.
那顶旧帽子看起来有点破旧。
Is that shabby doll your mother's old toy?
那个破旧的娃娃是妈妈的旧玩具吗？
What a shabby bench in the park!
公园里这条长椅好破旧呀！
shackles: We read about shackles in our book.
我们在书上读到了镣铐的历史。
Were the shackles in the story very old?
故事里的镣铐是很久很久以前的吗？
Never use shackles on people or animals!
绝不能给人或动物戴镣铐！
shamrock: The little shamrock has three green leaves.
小三叶草有三片绿叶子。
Can you find a shamrock in the grass?
你能在草丛里找到三叶草吗？
Find a small shamrock near the big rock!
在大石头附近找一株小三叶草吧！
shantytown: The story tells about a shantytown near the city.
这个故事讲了城市附近一片棚户区的事。
Did the people in the shantytown need help?
棚户区的人们需要帮助吗？
The old shantytown got new little houses!
旧棚户区盖起了新房子！
sharpshooter: The sharpshooter on the stage has good eyes.
舞台上的神枪手眼神特别好。
Is the sharpshooter a girl in the story?
故事里的神枪手是个女孩吗？
We love the sharpshooter in the circus!
我们喜欢马戏团里的神枪手！
shears: Grandfather uses big shears in the garden.
爷爷在花园里用大剪刀。
Where did you put the garden shears?
你把园艺大剪刀放哪儿了？
shellfish: A crab is a shellfish from the ocean.
螃蟹是一种带硬壳的海鲜。
Do you like to eat shellfish at the beach?
你喜欢在海边吃海鲜吗？
Look at that shellfish under the wet rock!
快看湿石头下面的那只带壳小家伙！
shipwright: The shipwright makes boats by the ocean.
Did the shipwright work near the big docks?
那位造船匠是在大码头附近工作的吗？
What a fine boat the shipwright made!
造船匠造的这条船真漂亮！
shirk: Don't shirk your work at school.
在学校可不要偷懒躲活儿哦！
Does your brother shirk his work at home?
你哥哥在家会偷懒躲活儿吗？
The little bee never shirks its work.
小蜜蜂干活从来不偷懒。
shogun: The old shogun lived in a big house.
古时候的幕府将军住在大宅子里。
Did the shogun have a fine garden?
那位将军有一座漂亮的花园吗？
What a tall gate at the shogun's house!
将军宅子的大门好高呀！
shootout: My brother and I watch the shootout together.
我和哥哥一起看点球大战。
What is a shootout in a soccer game?
足球比赛里的点球大战是什么呀？
Our soccer game comes down to a shootout!
我们的足球赛最后进入了点球大战！
shot: His shot is too low for the basket.
他投的这一下太低，进不了篮筐。
Did you see my shot in the game?
你看到我比赛中的那一投了吗？
What a good shot at the basket!
shrine: We saw a small shrine near the old tree.
我们在老树附近看到一座小神社。
Did you see the shrine near the lake?
你看到湖边的那座神社了吗？
What a little shrine under the big rock!
大石头下面的小祠堂真小巧呀！
shroud: The long night can shroud the moon.
Does the white snow shroud the little plants?
白白的积雪会把小苗盖住吗？
Look how the snow shrouds the little trees!
shudder: Do you shudder when the night is cold?
夜里冷的时候你会打冷颤吗？
The old story gives me a shudder!
那个老故事听得我一哆嗦！
shuffle: Let's shuffle the cards and start the game.
咱们洗洗牌，开始游戏吧！
Can you shuffle the cards really fast?
I shuffle my feet in the new snow.
我踏着新雪，脚在地上蹭来蹭去。
shutter: The shutter closes when the rain comes.
下雨的时候，百叶窗会关上。
Does the camera shutter make a noise?
相机的快门会有声音吗？
What a green shutter on the old window!
旧窗户上的绿色百叶窗真好看！
siege: In the story, the fort was under siege.
Was the siege short in the story?
故事里的围攻时间短吗？
What a long siege for the little fort!
这座小堡垒被围了好久好久！
sighting: We had a seal sighting at the beach.
我们在海边看到了海豹。
Was the fox sighting near the forest?
那次看见狐狸是在森林附近吗？
Tell me about your whale sighting!
快跟我讲讲你看见鲸鱼的事吧！
significant: Today is a significant day for our team.
今天对我们队来说是重要的一天。
Was the new seed a significant find?
那颗新种子是个重要发现吗？
That was a significant day in our story!
那是我们故事里重要的一天！
signify: A red sign can signify stop.
What does the green light signify?
Yellow leaves signify the start of winter!
silhouette: We saw the silhouette of a bird at sunset.
日落时我们看到了一只鸟的剪影。
Can you draw my silhouette on the paper?
你能在纸上描出我的侧影吗？
Look at the black silhouette in the sky!
快看天上那个黑色的影子！
similar: My backpack is similar to your backpack.
Is your game similar to my game?
你的游戏和我的游戏相似吗？
The two white cats look so similar!
这两只白猫长得好像呀！
similarity: Find a similarity in the two stories.
在两个故事里找一个相同点吧。
What similarity can you find in the two books?
这两本书里你能找到什么相似之处呀？
Their similarity made them good friends.
相似的它们成了好朋友。
simile: White like snow is a simile in our book.
“白得像雪”是我们书里的一个明喻。
Can you find a simile in the story?
你能在故事里找到一个明喻吗？
Try writing a simile about your cat!
试着给你的猫写一个明喻吧！
simmer: Let the noodles simmer in the big pot.
让面条在大锅里小火慢煮。
Do the noodles simmer in a little water?
面条要在一点水里慢慢煮吗？
The hot pot simmers on the stove.
热锅在炉子上咕嘟咕嘟地煮着。
simulacra: Our toys are little simulacra of big animals.
我们的玩具是大动物们的小小仿制品。
Are toy dinosaurs simulacra of the big animals?
玩具恐龙是大恐龙的仿制品吗？
Look at the simulacra of dinosaurs in the book!
simulate: The game can simulate flying like a bird.
这个游戏能模拟像鸟儿一样飞。
Does the robot simulate how a dog walks?
机器人能模仿小狗走路吗？
Simulate a market with our toy food!
用玩具食物来模拟逛集市吧！
simulation: The simulation on the screen was very cool.
屏幕上的模拟演示太酷了。
Did you try the computer simulation at school?
你在学校试过电脑模拟吗？
What a fun simulation of a market day!
这个集市日的模拟游戏真好玩！
simulator: The pilot sits in the big simulator.
飞行员坐在大模拟器里。
Does the plane simulator feel like the sky?
飞行模拟器感觉像在天上一样吗？
What a cool simulator in the computer room!
机房里的模拟器太酷了！
singles: She plays singles in the tennis game.
她在网球比赛里打单打。
Did you play singles in tennis today?
你今天打网球单打了吗？
What a close singles game we saw!
我们看的这场单打真不分上下呀！
singular: mouse 这个词是单数形式。
What is the singular of these words?
这些词的单数形式是什么呀？
Find one singular word on this page!
在这一页上找一个单数形式的词吧！
sinister: The sinister fox in the story wants the eggs.
故事里那只阴险的狐狸想要那些蛋。
Is the crocodile in the movie sinister?
电影里的鳄鱼很阴险吗？
What a sinister laugh in the old story!
老故事里那声阴险的笑声真吓人！
sinkhole: A sinkhole is a big hole in the dirt.
天坑是泥土里陷出来的大洞。
Did you see the sinkhole near the big tree?
你看到大树旁的那个天坑了吗？
Never walk near a big sinkhole!
siren: The siren sits up high on the fire truck.
警笛高高地装在消防车上。
Do you hear the siren down the street?
你听到街那头的警笛声了吗？
What a big siren on that fire truck!
那辆消防车上的警笛好大呀！
skeptic: My brother is a skeptic about big fish stories.
我哥哥对那些吹大鱼的传闻总是不信。
Is your little sister a skeptic too?
你妹妹也是个爱怀疑的小家伙吗？
Don't be a skeptic, just try the new food!
别瞎怀疑啦，尝尝这个新食物吧！
skeptical: I was skeptical about the very long snake story.
我对那条超长蛇的传闻有点不信。
Are you skeptical about the big fish too?
你也不太相信那条大鱼吗？
It is good to be a little skeptical!
带着一点疑问去想问题挺好！
sketch: I made a fast sketch of my dog.
我快速给小狗画了一张速写。
Can you sketch the bird at the window?
你能给窗边的小鸟画张速写吗？
What a nice sketch in your art book!
你美术本上的这幅速写真不错！
skirmish: Our book tells about a skirmish at the fort.
书里讲了在堡垒发生的一次小冲突。
Was the skirmish in the story a short one?
故事里的那次小冲突时间短吗？
The little skirmish was over very fast!
那场小冲突很快就结束了！
skirmisher: In the story, a skirmisher watches the fort.
故事里，一名散兵守望着堡垒。
Did you read about the skirmisher at school?
你在学校读到过散兵的故事吗？
How fast that little skirmisher runs!
那个小散兵跑得可真快！
skit: We made a skit about school lunch.
我们编了一个关于学校午餐的小短剧。
Can I be a bear in the skit?
我能在小短剧里演一只熊吗？
What a fun skit on the big stage!
大舞台上的小短剧真有趣！
skyline: The city skyline looks big and tall at night.
夜晚的城市天际线又高又大。
Can you see the skyline from the tall building?
从高楼上你能看到天际线吗？
The sunset makes the skyline orange and pink!
落日把天际线染成橙色和粉色！
slaughter: People work to stop the slaughter of the turtles.
人们努力阻止对海龟的滥杀。
Can people stop the slaughter of the whales?
人们能停止对鲸鱼的滥杀吗？
Help stop the slaughter of the little turtles!
一起来保护小海龟，停止滥杀吧！
